name: Pixel Playground Default Baseline
rule: This is the default Pixel Playground baseline. Preserve all game mechanics and the arcade layout in future builds unless the user explicitly requests a change.
layout: Retro arcade: game list sidebar + selected game panel + compact controls tab

Asteroids.ship_speed: 50% of the previous V10 thrust/max-speed values

Breakout.paddle_hit_speed: multiply current ball speed by 1.05 (5% increase)

2048.movement: all tiles slide in the requested arrow-key direction

global.controls_ui: collapsible tab; opening it reduces the game stage rather than clipping the game

presentation.audio: Web Audio synthesized game start/end cues
presentation.responsive_scaling: fit every selected game to its available stage with a 2% safety margin; no internal game scrolling

layout_baseline: V18 no-clip page-scroll model + V20 centered Wordle/2048/Tetris + fixed dashboard identity/home
notes: Dashboard cleanup: yellow Pixel Playground home button, fixed player identity, remove legacy home heading, center Wordle/2048/Tetris compositions without changing mechanics.
